profiles.name: OKIMesh — standard MQTT brokers
profiles.description: The full OKIMesh default broker layout, slots 0-4 (firmware #701 form). Slot 0 is PLAINTEXT by design so it is exempt from TLS rotation and stays always-on; slots 1-4 are wss/TLS and rotate. No secrets, no region, no enabled state — set your own region and enable what you need on the device.
